name: Site check
desc: Several addresses checked at once -- every one started in the background before any of them is waited for -- and each answer sorted down one of three branches: up, slow or down. Both flowcharts are on the Steps tab, written in shapes rather than code, and what the window says about itself is worked out from the values.
vars:
sites = "https://example.com`nhttps://httpbin.org/status/404`nhttps://no-such-host.invalid"
checked = 0
good = 0
slow = 0
broken = 0
running = false
said <- (running ? "Checking " checked " at once..." : checked ? good " up, " slow " slow, " broken " down" : "Nothing checked yet")
canGo <- (!running && Trim(sites) != "")
anyBroken <- (broken > 0)

windows.name: Main
windows.title: Site check
windows.status: msg | One address a line, then Check them all | grow icon=E968
windows.flows:
clearBtn Click -> clearlist results
clearBtn Click -> assign checked 0
clearBtn Click -> assign good 0
clearBtn Click -> assign slow 0
clearBtn Click -> assign broken 0
clearBtn Click -> status msg Cleared.
windows.binds:
sitesBox <-> sites
sumLabel.Text <- said
goBtn.Enabled <- canGo
clearBtn.Enabled <- (checked > 0)
againBtn.Enabled <- anyBroken

kids.name: tip
kids.arg: Two flowcharts, both on the Steps tab. Check them all starts every address in the background BEFORE it waits for any of them -- that is what makes them run together rather than one after another -- and then sorts each answer down one of three branches: up, slow or down. Open either one on Steps and it is shapes, not code.

props.title: Branching and parallel, without writing code.

events.name: Click
events.code:
results.Component.Clear()
checked := 0
good := 0
slow := 0
broken := 0
running := true
AxBindSync()
jobs := []
addresses := []
; start them all before waiting for any: this is what makes it parallel
for line in StrSplit(StrReplace(sites, "`r"), "`n") {
    if (Trim(line) = "") {
        continue
    }
    addresses.Push(Trim(line))
    jobs.Push(Fetch(Trim(line)))
}
g.Status("msg", "Started " jobs.Length " at once -- the window still answers")
; and now collect them, each one down its own branch
for i, job in jobs {
    started := A_TickCount
    body := ""
    try {
        body := WaitFor(GiveUpAfter(job, 8000))
    }
    took := A_TickCount - started
    Sort(addresses[i], body, took)
}
running := false
AxBindSync()
g.Status("msg", "Done.")

kids.arg: Try the ones that were down

{Columns: [{Key: "site", Title: "Address", Width: 380, Icon: true},

            Badge: (v, *) => v = "Up" ? "good" : v = "Slow" ? "warn" : "bad"},
           {Key: "took", Title: "Took", Width: 110, Align: "right", Sort: "number",
            Format: (v, *) => v " ms"},
           {Key: "size", Title: "Size", Width: 110, Align: "right", Sort: "number"}],
 Rows: [], Empty: "Press Check them all."}
